empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a .md or .zip file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to see its config, preview and usage.

card.toggleLabel: Enable {name} for every agent that attaches it

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
config.namePattern: Use kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–64 characters.
config.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists.
config.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: when the reviewer should apply this skill and what to check. Example: “Use when tests change: flag untested branches and missing edge cases.”
config.tokensTitle: Estimate (characters ÷ 4). The exact count is in each run’s trace log.

deleteModal.title: Delete {name}?
deleteModal.body: {count, plural, =0 {No agent attaches it.} one {It is attached to # agent and will be detached from it.} other {It is attached to # agents and will be detached from them.}} This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.unsavedNote: Showing unsaved changes. Agents receive the saved version.
preview.disabledNote: Disabled: agents don’t receive this skill.

stats.windowNote: Runs of the last {days} days whose prompt included this skill, and the findings of those runs. Findings aren’t attributed to one skill: a run with several skills counts for each of them.
stats.empty: Not attached to any agent yet. Attach it from an agent’s Skills tab.
stats.loadError: Could not load this skill’s stats.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Only text is imported: SKILL.md from a .zip, or a .md file. Nothing in the file is run.
import.fileHint: .md or .zip, up to 1 MB. A .zip must hold SKILL.md at its root or in one top-level folder.
import.wrongType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read.
import.disabledNotice: Imported skills are saved disabled. Review the text, then enable it yourself.
